Extended Unit of Measure: Field with examples ACRE=Acre, CMET=Centimeter; see Appendix for values.
Other Tax Included Indicator: Sub-table 07 indicates whether unit cost includes national tax.

Loyalty Processing Status: Numeric code indicating loyalty processing result status.

Discover Network Retrieval Reference Number: Identifies the Discover Network Retrieval Reference Number.
Card Expiration Date: Identifies expiration date in TA-VE processing transaction; Table ID fixed value 013.

Spend Qualified Indicator: Identifies Visa spend qualified indicator for annual POS spending requirements.
Host Prompts Table Data: Identifies additional prompts to request and send on Completion message.

Product Code Set: Code set identifier, e.g. 001 for NACS.

Voyager Restriction Code: Table ID 046, contains product restriction from Voyager in unspecified format.
